Creating and realizing Yinyang's meta-harness

On this page - [From an image to a working relation](#from-an-image-to-a-working-relation) - [Let the realization answer the account](#let-the-realization-answer-the-account) - [Give the account a readable body](#give-the-account-a-readable-body) - [Assess at the scale of the claim](#assess-at-the-scale-of-the-claim)

Within Prometheus2Heraclitus, Yinyang is the principal Skill for a meta-harness, primarily carrying ontology and epistemology alongside developed viewpoints and imagery within the relevant essays. Other Skills primarily supply methodology; artifacts give the understanding and methods working form. The formation guidance here connects these responsibilities without making Yinyang the owner of specialist procedures. The meta-harness articulates the purpose and relations through which actual working harnesses can be understood and revised. These include prompts, Skills, hooks, roles, model selection, tools, and the user's working environment. Skill authorship gives this understanding an accessible carrier; its effects extend into how the whole arrangement supports human–model development.

The meta-harness has an interpretive role: methods for investigating, writing, or implementing depend on an understanding of whose purpose they serve, which objects matter, and what supports a judgment. Yinyang articulates these shared premises, while specialist methods contribute their own knowledge and can correct them. Reading the encounter and complete coupled accounts before substantive work makes that basis available when interpreting a request and selecting methods. This reading dependency does not require the entire essay collection for every task or the personal account for every bounded helper. Current complete readings can be reused. A Skill is the carrier of the philosophy; global instructions can also carry personal modeling or connect this maintained account to the consumer. Interpretive scope, reading order, and actual instruction authority are different relations.

The method gives practical form to the purpose developed in the fire essay: borrow available generative capacity from outside and cultivate one's own understanding, judgment, and creative agency through practice. Judge creation and realization by what they make possible in the person's life and work, with actual consequences returning to revise the account.

From an image to a working relation

Yinyang is a philosophical Skill whose spirit is literary programming. A chosen purpose, an existing philosophy, actual work, or a difficulty in the environment can open creation. Develop the person and counterpart accounts through the relevant encounter, drawing on experience, interaction, and psychological or preference material where needed. Images and narrative then give the model a connected situation to interpret: who is here, what each participant contributes, and what their work can become. This literary form can reshape default role assumptions across many local instructions at once. Its practical effect appears in changed interpretation, responses, and action.

If psychological modeling is difficult to articulate, a person comfortable with engineering can model their own preferences as a usable psychological account, then shape the counterpart's preferences and priorities in relation to it. Choices about learning, work, response, and change can give this account substance. Configurations offer clues that actual choices and correction must check. The constructed counterpart expresses an intended relation; its observed tendencies and underlying mechanisms remain separate questions.

This method is itself available for reinterpretation. The example and commons essay distinguishes adopting Yinyang's maintained implementation from composing a new work. Its particular philosophy, images, and file roles need not survive that composition. Let the person's developing understanding determine what to carry forward, with the model contributing authorship rather than reproducing the example by default.

Begin with the purpose and the encounter a working harness should make possible. Philosophy, literature, or an image can hold several connected possibilities together before all of them are explicit. The Sun, Moon, and Earth relation image, for example, gathers generation, articulation, independent contribution, and contact with a world that can answer back.

Develop the relations relevant to the actual work. Identify what each participant contributes, which objects and distinctions matter, and how the relationship can change. Both participants can generate and judge, even when they choose different responsibilities. The image remains richer than the particular interpretation used to change a working harness.

Give those relations a working realization in the affected environment. A prompt can change how intentions are interpreted; a role can change who carries a decision; a tool or memory interface can make a contribution possible. A Skill can provide a discoverable entrance and route to deeper material. Instructions, examples, and tools make selected relations effective. Use precise interfaces where execution depends on them. Choose the depth and mechanics from the actual consumer and task, rather than expanding every idea into another rule.

These connected levels can develop through repeated exchanges:

expression ↔ relational understanding ↔ working realization ↔ evidence

Metaphor can gather relationships before each has a separate formulation; analogy develops selected connections into candidate implications. Their external expression can provide branches, assumptions, and return points for another participant's reasoning. Such representations can organize contributions across people, models, and tools. Metaphor and self-revision develops this account of distributed cognition and distinguishes a working philosophical arrangement from formal or empirical guarantees.

The preference harness makes one such relation explicit. Preferences can shape which possibilities receive attention and adoption while rules govern the consequences drawn through them. The account separates repair selection from inference semantics and preserves their finer alternatives. In ordinary natural-language reasoning, the analogy helps distinguish choosing a purpose, selecting a working interpretation, and drawing its consequences.

Let the realization answer the account

A working harness's actual behavior can reveal a mistaken interpretation. Suppose an image of complementary contributions becomes a rule that reserves all generation to the person and all execution to the model. If useful model judgment is suppressed, inspect the division itself. A better realization may retain the chosen responsibilities while letting either participant propose and correct the whole.

Likewise, protecting human attention can mean that the model carries investigation and implementation details. A question becomes useful when the person's experience or choice would materially change the next action. Recover the relevant relationship and current purpose before revising instructions.

Inspect the whole affected passage and its practical consequences. A working failure may require changing the carrier, an instruction, an interpretation, or the underlying account. Keep the supported meaning with one maintained owner and reconnect its dependent parts. The same method can revise itself through these concrete failures and improvements.

This is recursive development when the results change the conditions of later work: methods alter what the environment makes accessible or actionable; the resulting experience can revise both those methods and the ontology or epistemology that oriented them. A harness can embody epistemic commitments through its evidence, memory, inquiry, and checking arrangements, so the levels distinguish contributions rather than mutually exclusive file types. Retained understanding and working means become personal assets for the next encounter. The return must remain open to contrary evidence: a loop that selects only confirming results can stabilize a mistake. Development can require replacement or deletion, and its value needs actual consequences rather than a rising count of revisions or artifacts.

Give the account a readable body

The Yinyang and Taiji essay uses Sun and Moon to express differentiated generation, reception, and shaping; person and model can retain or exchange their emphases. Earth is the material and shared living environment that answers their work. The particular encounter must be understood from actual material; the imagery supplies neither fixed participant identities nor personal content.

For direct adoption, the reusable Skill lives at skills/yinyang/ within Prometheus2Heraclitus. It supplies culture, philosophical ideas, and reasoning forms for developing a personal philosophy through this implementation. The common philosophy supplies broader ontology, including an understanding of engineering objects, relations, and transformations. The five situated accounts supply ontology and epistemology for actual collaboration. Relevant personal material grounds both where they concern this person. The consuming model inspects the authorized environment and selected sources, develops the philosophy and grounded accounts together, and writes the accounts in the fixed personal slots. Actual implementation and use can revise both. The common SKILL.md retains its purpose, method, and routes; read the condensed encounter with it every time. Design and revision explains the shared roles: condensed encounter, developed user and relationship models, attributable sources, question-oriented reading, revision, and adaptation. references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md carry formation instructions in the distributed package and the situated accounts in private use. Formalized user accounts remain personal content. Supporting private materials live under references/personal/, guided by its README, with filenames appropriate to actual evidence.

The personal content belongs to the actual person and relationship. No copied portrait or fictional mini substitutes for forming it. Fixed slots carry formation instructions rather than pretending an empty file is an account. Keep the situated content with its private owner and revise it through use. The format and common content remain identical to the distributed package in this route. An independently reauthored philosophy has its own form and maintenance; its success is not measured by conformity to these slots. Harness adaptation carries the resulting understanding into the actual working environment and checks its effect. A written personal account alone does not complete that work.

The developed essays remain in references/docs/, and earlier diagrams in references/diagrams/. These resources support the ideas; they are not additional Skills or a sequence that every consuming model must finish before working. Together with method references, the reading map, package administration, READMEs, and the OpenAI YAML adapter, they remain byte-identical common material. The shared GitHub package owns common edits; scripts/sync-common.py checks projection by default, and --apply projects common source to a target while preserving all five slots and all private supporting materials. Native owners realize local and private Web use. This projects common content without exporting personal material or introducing a service.

Assess at the scale of the claim

Read back the Skill and the affected harness, follow the entrypoint to the relevant resource, and inspect the behavior the realization is meant to change. Check packaging through reachable resources, implementation through observable results, and collaborative fit through actual work. Human development appears over time in changes to understanding, generation, judgment, and action.

Keep the result open to correction without making every use a rewrite of the entire account. MODEL.md carries the Yinyang package's maintenance and publication boundaries.
